    AI Overview
    St. John's University
    is a private Roman Catholic university primarily located in the Queens borough of New York City. Founded in 1870, its main campus is in Jamaica, Queens, with additional city campuses in Staten Island and Manhattan, as well as locations in Rome, Italy, and beyond. 
    Key details about the location include: 
    • Main Campus: Queens (Jamaica, NY)
    • Other Campus Locations: Staten Island, Manhattan, and Oakdale (NY)
    • City: New York City
